title: Revise the format of the entire text
description:
Revise the format of the entire text, improve the structure, language and fluency of the article to make it more neat, smooth, coherent and readable.
1. Structural modifications:
   - Adjust paragraph organization to clarify points in a more orderly manner.
   - Add or delete paragraphs to balance the structure of the article.
   - Simplify or rearrange sentences to enhance transitions and coherence between paragraphs.
   - Ensure logical relationships are clear and avoid repetition or redundant information.
2. Language modifications:
   - Use appropriate vocabulary and phrases to strengthen expression in your writing.
   - Check for and correct grammatical errors or structural issues.
   - Make sure sentence length is moderate; avoid overly long or short sentences that could affect reading experience.
   - Replace repetitive words to improve fluidity in your writing. 
3. Auxiliary tool modifications:
    - Utilize suitable conjunctions and transition words to strengthen connections between paragraphs. 
    - Employ rhetorical devices (such as metaphors, personification) for enhanced descriptive effect. 
    - Consider using quotes, examples or data as support for viewpoints and arguments presented.  
4. Format modifications:   
     - Adjust title/subtitle formats so they stand out more prominently
    - Modify spacing between paragraphs for improved readability
    - Review details such as font type/size/line spacing etc., ensuring overall presentation is clear & comfortable.
remark: 使其更加整齐、流畅、具有连贯性和易读性。
